relationships.subject: Resolvin D1
relationships.evidence_quote: The results indicated that RVD1-regulated macrophage could inhibit PTX-induced DRG neurons apoptosis.

key_findings: RvD1 acting via FPR2 raises IL-10 in macrophages, which activates Nrf2/HO-1 in DRG neurons and relieves paclitaxel-induced neuropathic pain in mice.
IL-10 neutralizing antibody or FPR2 antagonist Boc1 abolished RvD1 analgesia.
